name: Uncommon Process Execution from Suspicious Directory
description: This hunt identifies uncommon process executions from suspicious directories on Linux systems. It looks for processes executed from directories that are often associated with malicious activity, such as /dev/shm, /var/www, /boot, /srv, /tmp, /var/tmp, /run, and /var/run. The goal is to detect potentially malicious processes while excluding common, benign ones.
hypothesis: An executable launched from a world-writable or web-served directory, seen on few hosts and only a few times, may be dropped malware or an attacker tool.

analystNotes: Excluded /tmp, /var/tmp files starting or ending with digits to exclude real temporary files.
Included a process or parent process count of <= 3, and a host count of <= 3 to eliminate common processes across different hosts.
expectedFalsePositives: Build, test and deployment tooling that runs generated binaries from /tmp or /var/www.
Package installation scripts executing from temporary directories.
suggestedPivots: Pivot on process.executable and host.name for the full process tree.
Check how the file arrived (download, web request, scp) shortly before execution.
Look for persistence (cron, systemd, rc files) created by the same user.

query.query:
from logs-endpoint.events.process-*
| where host.os.type == "linux" and event.type == "start" and event.action == "exec" and (
  process.executable like "/dev/shm/*" or
  process.executable like "/var/www/*" or
  process.executable like "/boot/*" or
  process.executable like "/srv/*" or
  process.executable rlike "/tmp/[^/]+" or
  process.executable rlike "/var/tmp/[^/]+" or
  process.executable rlike "/run/[^/]+" or
  process.executable rlike "/var/run/[^/]+"
) and not (
  process.parent.executable in ("/usr/sbin/dpkg-preconfigure") or
  process.executable rlike "/tmp/[0-9].*" or
  process.executable rlike "/tmp/.*[0-9]/?" or
  process.executable rlike "/var/tmp/[0-9].*" or
  process.executable rlike "/var/tmp/.*[0-9]/?"
)
| eval parent_executable = coalesce(process.parent.executable, "unknown")
| stats cc = count(), host_count = count_distinct(host.name), last_seen = max(@timestamp) by process.executable, parent_executable
// Alter this threshold to make sense for your environment
| where cc <= 3 and host_count <= 3
| sort cc asc
query.surroundingEventQuery:
from logs-endpoint.events.process-* METADATA _index, _id
| where @timestamp >= {{param.bucket_start}} and @timestamp < {{param.bucket_end}}
| where host.os.type == "linux" and event.type == "start" and event.action == "exec" and (
  process.executable like "/dev/shm/*" or
  process.executable like "/var/www/*" or
  process.executable like "/boot/*" or
  process.executable like "/srv/*" or
  process.executable rlike "/tmp/[^/]+" or
  process.executable rlike "/var/tmp/[^/]+" or
  process.executable rlike "/run/[^/]+" or
  process.executable rlike "/var/run/[^/]+"
) and not (
  process.parent.executable in ("/usr/sbin/dpkg-preconfigure") or
  process.executable rlike "/tmp/[0-9].*" or
  process.executable rlike "/tmp/.*[0-9]/?" or
  process.executable rlike "/var/tmp/[0-9].*" or
  process.executable rlike "/var/tmp/.*[0-9]/?"
)
| eval parent_executable = coalesce(process.parent.executable, "unknown")
| where process.executable == {{param.process.executable}} and parent_executable == {{param.parent_executable}}
| sort @timestamp desc
| keep _index, _id, @timestamp, host.name, user.name, process.executable, process.parent.executable, process.command_line
